questions.q: What is the main purpose of a Record Type?
options: To create a brand-new object
To permanently delete unused picklist values
To let a single object support multiple kinds of record, each with its own available picklist values and page layout
To rename a standard object
questions.explain: A Record Type lets one object represent more than one business process without creating a second object, by narrowing picklist values and assigning a page layout per Record Type.

questions.q: When a Record Type narrows a picklist to fewer values, what happens to the values that were removed?
options: They become required fields instead
They still exist on the field's master list — they're just not offered to this Record Type
They are moved to a different field
They are permanently deleted from the field everywhere
questions.explain: A Record Type only controls which of the field's master values are offered to someone creating a record under it; the full master list is untouched.

questions.q: Besides picklist values, what else does setting up a Record Type assign?
options: A new Object Manager tab
A Salesforce license type
A Lookup Filter
A page layout, which can vary by profile
questions.explain: Creating or editing a Record Type walks through assigning it a page layout, and that assignment can vary by profile.

questions.q: Two users with different profiles both create a record under the same Record Type. Can they see different page layouts?
options: Only if they also have different Record Types
No, a Record Type always shows exactly one layout to everyone
Yes, page layout assignment for a Record Type can vary per profile
Only on custom objects, never standard objects
questions.explain: Record Type page layout assignment is per profile, so two profiles can see different layouts for the same Record Type and the same underlying record.

questions.q: A Partner Account and a Customer Account both live on the Account object. What single piece of configuration most directly explains why they show different Type picklist values?
options: A Roll-Up Summary field
A Lookup Filter on the Type field
They are actually two different objects behind the scenes
Their Record Type
questions.explain: Record Type is what narrows which picklist values are available to a given kind of record, even though both records share the same object and field.
